sloka: श्रुत्वा ऽगस्त्यस्य कथितं रामः सौमित्रिरेव च ।विस्मयं परमं जग्मुर्वानरा राक्षसैः सह ।। ७.३६.५२ ॥
transliteration: śrutvā 'gastyasya kathitaṁ rāmaḥ saumitrireva ca ।vismayaṁ paramaṁ jagmurvānarā rākṣasaiḥ saha ।। 7.36.52 ॥

translations.english: Having heard what Agastya narrated, Rama, Lakshmana, and also the monkeys along with the Rakshasas, were filled with great astonishment.
